summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals and updates, including enhancements to the REST catalog for credential management and the introduction of finer-grained read restrictions. Additionally, the community is actively addressing license issues to unblock the upcoming releases, including Iceberg 1.11.0 and 1.12.0.
highlights: Proposal for adding relative paths to v4 spec
Discussion on credential management for KMS/Vault in REST catalog
Efforts to unblock Iceberg 1.11.0 and 1.12.0 releases
